content: Sauli najombi jabii apalapala, jatenda kujetake lijambu lukunkoma Sitivini. Sauli juling'alisa bandu babuhobale Kilisitu Lisoba lee lela bandu babuhobale Kilisitu buku Yelusalemu latumbulia kung'alika ngamaa. Bandu boka ba bunhobale Sapanga, kulekape atumi baka Yesu, babaganiki kutili ku Yudea nuku Samalia.
Bandu bangi babumpala Sapanga buntaga Sitivini nukunndele ngamaa.
Lakini Sauli jatumbuliya kwaakoma bandu babuhobale Kilisitu, jajingala kila nyumba na kwakamuu bandu ba ahobale aka mbomba na akanalomi na kwaajege muligelesa.
Lijambu la Amboni bililandi ku Samalia
Bandu ba ahobale babaganiki bala, bajenda kila pandu koni baka landila Lijambu la Amboni laka Sapanga.
Najombi Pilipi jajenda ku musi nkolongu juku Samalia na kaalandi bandu baatama kola Lijambu la Amboni laka Yesu Kilisitu.
Bandu pabajowa malobi gaka Pilipi nukujibona ndonduke je jwatenda, baamua kunzogwane namangani.
Ilombu yaapita bandu bingi, koni ipega keleli, bandu baalei nhyega na bini ilema boti batenda kulama.
Musi gola gwoka wabii nalaa ngamaa.
Henu jwabii mundu jumu bunkema Simoni jatenda uhabi muda gwingi mmusi jemola, bandu boka buku Samalia bunsangii jombi, najombi jukipuna kubanga jombi mundu nkolongu.
Bandu boka akolongu na asoku, bunzowanakiya ngamaa nukupwaga, “Mundu ajoo jubii nu uwesu waka Sapanga gobugukema, ‘Uwesu Nkolongu.’ ”
Bandu bingi bumpwata jombi ndaba jeni jaasangisi bombi kupetee uhabi waki.
Lakini pabahobali malandi gaka Pilipi pajaalandila Lijambu la Amboni lukolongu waka Sapanga ni liina laka Yesu Kilisitu, aka mbomba na akanalomi baamua kubatiswa.
Simoni najombi jatenda kuhobale nuku batiswa. Jaamua kumpwata Pilipi kila pandu, koni jusangaa nginyuli na ndonduke yejuibona.
Atumi baka Yesu bababi ku Yelusalemu pabajowana bandu buku Samalia bilijetaki lilobi laka Sapanga, baatuma Petili na Yohana ajendaa nabombi.
Pabaika ku Samalia baalobila kwaka Sapanga bandu boka bahobale nabombi ajopa Loho jaka Sapanga
Ndaba jeni Loho jaka Sapanga jabii ngase junhuluki mundu hata jumu, babipee atei kabatisa kupete liina laka Yesu.
Ndipala Petili na Yohana babekila maboku panani jabu, nabombi bajopa Loho jaka Sapanga.
Simoni pajabona bandu ajopiki Loho jaka Sapanga kupete kwaabeke maboku gaka atumi baka Yesu panani jabu, japala kwapeke lupija Petili na Yohana nakaapwagi,
“Nanepani kabee mmbekiya uwesu wehogu, nane jokapi jonammbekila maboku gangu panani jaki, jujopa Loho jaka Sapanga.”
Petili jajibua, “Lupija lwaku luobila kutali pamu na wamweti, ndaba guholale guwesa kulomba nhupi jaka Sapanga kupete lupija!
Wehapa ngase gubii na pandu wala haki jokapi jukutenda lihengu laka Sapanga ndaba jeni mwoju waku ngasegubii sapi palongi jaka Sapanga.
Nala gujetakia mahakau gaku nukugaleka, ndi hundoba Bambu najombi kwaa juwesa kugulekake mawasu gaku gehaga.
Ndaba nugubweni ubii nu usungu ngamaa kabee ubii mukipungu sa mahakau.”
Ndienu Simoni jaapwagila Petili na Yohana, “Nandi munobila kwaka Bambu, goka gampwagiki giimbata nandino.”
Petili na Yohana pabajomula kupwaga gabagabona babuja ku Yelusalemu. Pababii mwindela balandila Lijambu la Amboni laka Sapanga mu ijiji ingipi yuku Samalia.
Pilipu ambatisa Towashi juku Esiopia
Atumi baka Bambu bu kunani ampwagila Pilipi, “Gujiandia kujenda upandi ukusini kupete ndela jejiuma ku Yelusalemu kujenda ku Gaza jejibii ku lungwenza.”

Najombi Pilipu juliandila nukujenda. Hejwabii mwindela, jwaketangana nu nkolongu jumu towashi juku Esiopia. Mundu hoju jwabii kilongosi, lihengu laki labii kujemalee hindu yoka yaka Kandake malikia juku Esiopia. Jwapiti ku Yelusalemu kunndumbali Sapanga enu jutendika kubuja jwatemi muligali laki lelihutwa na maponda.
Pajukubika jubuja kunyumba jaki koni jutemi muligali laki jabia jusoma kitabu saka Isaya Mlota waka Sapanga.
Loho jaka Sapanga jumpwagila Pilipi, “Gujenda pambipi ni ligali lelabii lihutwa na maponda gupwatana nalu.”
Pilipi julijommbatakiya ligali lelihutwa na maponda lela, najombi anzogwana mundu jola jusoma kitabu saka Mlota Isaya. Pilipu anndalukya, “Boo guelewa lee gagusoma geaga?”
Najombi jwajibua, “Niwesa boo kuelewa bila mundu kunongowa?” Jaamua kunndoba Pilipi jukwela muligali lelihutwa na maponda nukutama pamu.
Nkolongu jola jusomika lipungu la maandiku ganga,

content: Mundu juku Esiopia jola jwaamua kundaluki Pilipi, “Nagumbwagila, mlota hoju anndongale nyane? Jililongale mweni au mundu jonge?”
Ndipala Pilipi jatumbuliya nilipungu la maandiku agalaga gajabia jwakasoma, kulandi Lijambu la Amboni laka Yesu.
Pabaendaliya na sapwali, bahika pandu papabii na masi na kilongosi jola anndalukya Pilipu, “Pamba masi gabi boo, kibi lee sindu sukumbenga nee kubatiswa?”
Pilipu jajibwa, “Ana guhobale kwa mwoju waku woka uwesa kubatiswa.” Najombi jajibwa, “Nehobale Yesu Kilisitu Mwana waka Sapanga.”
Alafu jwaamulisa ligali lelihutwa na maponda lela lijema. Boka abeli Pilipi na Towashi jola bahulukaniya nukujingi mu masi na Pilipi ambatisa nkolongu jola.
Pabapita kunza ja masi, Loho jaka Sapanga jaka Bambo junzukua Pilipi nu kuboka naku kwa gafula nu nkolongu jola ngaseambweni kabee, lakini jwaendaliya kubuja koni jutogule.
Pilipi julibona jubii ku Azotu, jwaamua kupete kila musi kulandi mbaka pajwaikaa ku Kaisalia.
